notes.title: Updates 20.03.25
notes.content:
- Increased explosion radius.
- Reversed bullets are now camera-traced.
- Health increases by 10 points when an enemy is killed.
- Health pills now restore more health, increased from 15 to 17.5 points.
- Updated bullet hole decal texture to make it more noticeable.
- Enemies now shoot at intervals of 0.45s–0.65s instead of 0.25s–0.45s.
